winks.rationale: The plain word 'Badger' is the name of real US towns (e.g. Badger, South Dakota; Badger, Minnesota).
The word 'Marble' is an exact match for Marble, Colorado, a real town.
The word 'Cameron' is an exact match for several US towns/counties (Cameron, Texas; Cameron Parish, Louisiana).
The word 'Holbrook' is an exact match for real US towns (Holbrook, Massachusetts; Holbrook, New York).
The plain word 'coral' appears directly in real US place names like Cape Coral and Coral Gables, Florida.
The word 'Coronado' is an exact match for Coronado, California, a real city and island.
The plain word 'Phoenix' is the name of a real town in New York (independent of the famous Arizona city).
The surname 'Johnson' is a real US place name (Johnson City, Tennessee; Johnson County).
